brief.summary: Matilda Djerf's own label: easy Scandinavian femininity in soft, natural-feeling fabrics. Fitted baby tees and scoop tanks, fine-knit cardigans buttoned as tops, relaxed straight jeans and wide trousers, slip and midi skirts, crisp oversized shirts, linen sets in summer. Mostly cream, white and denim with sky blue, butter yellow and soft pink stripes; ballet flats, loafers and a soft shoulder bag. Pretty, clean and wearable, never sweet or fussy.
signatures: fitted baby tee or scoop tank
fine-knit cardigan buttoned as a top
oversized striped or white poplin shirt
satin or cotton midi slip skirt
silhouettes: midi skirt with a short knit
